turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
I'm here about the zero on Owen's essay. Who decided it?
Can I ask something off the record?
There's no off the record in this meeting. Who decided on the zero?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned here. Answer mine: who decided on the zero, and when?
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.

Are you calling my son a cheater, Hale, and me negligent, with nothing in front of you? Twice now you've talked about me instead of the essay. Either show me what you have or I'm walking to the principal's office.
